summary: Prototype observability-centric reusable metric panels in stui and Fractal; opt-in only.

replay.detail: No services, seats, stored claims or fleet configuration are changed by this prototype.

schema.detail: No durable state or st API schema changes. A new generated metric-panel/1 document is emitted only by opt-in client modes.

rules.detail: No services, seats, stored claims or fleet configuration are changed by this prototype.

compatibility.detail: Existing tabs, resource drawers, CLI behavior and daemon protocols are unchanged. This is a bakeoff branch, not a rollout.

downtime.detail: No services, seats, stored claims or fleet configuration are changed by this prototype.

manual.detail: Use --metric-panels, --metric-panels-json or --metric-panels-text; configure METRIC_HOST and the existing st/Mimir endpoints as described in crates/stui/README.md.

recovery.detail: No services, seats, stored claims or fleet configuration are changed by this prototype.
